cause: The gate treated the current intersection as both observed state and expected identity, so it had no independent inventory against which to detect a missing source or packaged side.
prevention: Pin an exact reviewed expected-common path inventory; block either missing side and unexpected common additions; keep source-only and template-only deletion regressions.
summary: A mirror gate derived from the current source/template intersection accepts deletion from either side because the path disappears from the governed set.
title: Intersection parity cannot detect a missing side
